scope: Optional source-bound preparation annotations in standalone run-document inputs

contracts.cli: runner create --discover, optionally combined with explicit --context; no target import or execution
contracts.storage: One whole-root binding per discovered variable owner/name, concrete data shapes and independent scalar missing markers; BYTE remains unknown
contracts.preservation: Compatible supplied context retains values, partial data, spelling, comments and unrelated services; conflicting discovered root types reject preparation
contracts.banks: Explicit supplied numeric/string/grouped position/port configuration only; no invented counts or values; remaining addresses and default groups require review
contracts.editing: JSON pointers are relative to inputs.context; variable pointers select whole roots and logical selectors identify source fields/indexes
contracts.annotations: Preparation snapshot only; supplied/missing/unmapped statuses and requirements do not refresh after edits or guarantee readiness
contracts.identity: Check raw Python pin during preparation and optional annotation envelope identity before running; checks do not authenticate code
contracts.execution: Existing runtime reads and services determine outcomes; conditional missing values may remain on untaken paths; inputs and annotations retained on failure/replay
contracts.compatibility: Existing run-v1 context-only documents remain supported; optional inputs.template adds source discovery, bindings and requirements
contracts.limits: At most 32767 newly materialized scalar leaves; unsupported schemas/budgets remain explicit requirements; existing JSON/document limits apply
